tasks.title: Extend artifact type definitions for cleaned intent and retrieval recommendations
tasks.description: Update the v1 artifact type definitions so intent capture can store a cleaned intent and retrieval artifacts can carry explicit default evidence recommendations, selection tiers, and strategy metadata.
tasks.deliverable: Revised v1 artifact type definitions aligned with the agentic retrieval roadmap
acceptance_criteria: intent-capture-v1 can represent raw user input and cleaned user intent
retrieval-index-v1 can represent selected/reserve candidates and explicit recommended_evidence data
Type definitions remain coherent for store, conductor, retriever, and assembler callers

tasks.title: Update runtime validators and fixtures for revised v1 contracts
tasks.description: Extend runtime schema validation and sample artifact fixtures to cover the new v1 intent and retrieval fields without introducing a version bump.
tasks.deliverable: Validated revised v1 schemas and fixtures for intent capture and retrieval artifacts
acceptance_criteria: Revised v1 artifact shapes validate successfully on the happy path
Invalid or incomplete retrieval recommendation structures fail with clear errors
Sample fixtures reflect the new contract and validate cleanly

tasks.title: Implement intent-file extraction and cleaned-intent helpers
tasks.description: Add utilities that parse inline <file name=...> blocks from the initial user intent, extract tagged file paths, and build bounded restatement context without granting general conductor-side repo browsing.
tasks.deliverable: Reusable helper for extracting tagged files, cleaned intent text, and bounded user-supplied file context
acceptance_criteria: Inline user-supplied file blocks are parsed into stable path references and cleaned intent text
Tagged files are derived deterministically from the initial intent
Restatement context generation is bounded and does not expose arbitrary repo reads

tasks.title: Wire Stage 1 capture and restatement to use user-supplied file context
tasks.description: Update the extension entrypoint and Stage 1 controller so intent capture persists raw and cleaned intent, and restatement model calls can use user-supplied file context before approval.
tasks.deliverable: Stage 1 flow that uses included intent files during restatement and persists cleaned intent metadata
acceptance_criteria: Initial restatement receives cleaned intent plus bounded included-file context
Intent capture artifacts persist tagged files and cleaned intent data
No new general-purpose conductor repo-reading capability is introduced

tasks.title: Update expansion and retrieval inputs to consume cleaned intent
tasks.description: Ensure downstream expansion and retrieval assembly use the cleaned user intent rather than inheriting large inline file bodies from the original message.
tasks.deliverable: Expansion and retrieval inputs grounded in cleaned intent while preserving tagged file references
acceptance_criteria: Expansion uses cleaned user intent by default
Retrieval prompt assembly does not embed entire inline file bodies from the initial message
Tagged files remain available to expansion and retrieval logic

tasks.title: Extract deterministic scout module and curated search-term generation
tasks.description: Factor the current heuristic retrieval logic into a deterministic scout module that crafts intent-shaped search terms from cleaned intent, restatement, retrieval focus, and tagged files.
tasks.deliverable: Dedicated scout pass with deterministic curated term generation
acceptance_criteria: Scout term generation is deterministic and no longer a naive split-all-words strategy
Tagged files and retrieval focus materially influence scout term selection
Scout logic is separated from the later model-driven retrieval loop

tasks.title: Produce ranked scout candidates with selection tiers and role hints
tasks.description: Extend the scout to emit a narrow selected/reserve candidate set with rationale, file role hints, top symbol candidates, and default-evidence mode hints suitable for the retriever agent's first turn.
tasks.deliverable: Deterministic scout output with selected and reserve candidates plus rationale
acceptance_criteria: Scout output distinguishes selected and reserve candidates
Each selected candidate includes a stable rationale and role hint
Scout output remains intentionally narrow and bounded

tasks.title: Integrate the scout into retrieval dispatch and add deterministic scout tests
tasks.description: Route retrieval dispatch through the new scout pass and add tests that lock in deterministic candidate narrowing, tagged-file boosting, and curated-term behavior.
tasks.deliverable: Retrieval dispatch seeded by scout output with dedicated scout regression coverage
acceptance_criteria: Retrieval dispatch runs the scout before any model-driven retrieval work
Scout tests prove deterministic candidate selection and tagged-file boosting
The candidate set is measurably narrower than the old single-pass heuristic default

tasks.title: Define retriever agent protocol, prompts, and round contracts
tasks.description: Introduce the structured protocol for a bounded model-driven retriever agent, including round input/output shapes, prompt assembly, and explicit action types.
tasks.deliverable: Typed retriever-agent protocol and prompt modules
acceptance_criteria: Retriever-agent round contracts are fully typed
Prompts constrain the agent to structured JSON actions and bounded behavior
Protocol design supports stop/continue semantics and final recommended_evidence output

tasks.title: Implement deterministic retrieval action executor
tasks.description: Build the deterministic executor that performs retriever-agent actions such as reading files, searching content, searching paths, and following imports within strict bounds.
tasks.deliverable: Bounded retrieval action executor for the model-driven retriever agent
acceptance_criteria: Supported action types are executed deterministically within repo bounds
File observations are bounded by explicit line/byte limits
Executor results are suitable for the next retriever-agent round without storing raw content in artifacts

tasks.title: Implement bounded retriever agent loop with injected model callback
tasks.description: Add the bounded round loop that combines scout output, model guidance, and deterministic executor observations to select files, symbols, and default evidence scope.
tasks.deliverable: Working bounded retriever-agent orchestration inside the retrieval boundary
acceptance_criteria: Retriever-agent rounds terminate under explicit round and action caps
The agent can read files, follow leads, and emit final recommended_evidence selections
Model-calling details stay at the extension edge or dispatch boundary rather than leaking into conductor logic

tasks.title: Add retriever-agent tests for bounded behavior and false-positive rejection
tasks.description: Create test coverage for the retriever agent's bounded loop, including file reads, import following, stop conditions, and rejection of false-positive candidates.
tasks.deliverable: Retriever-agent regression suite covering bounded multi-round behavior
acceptance_criteria: Tests prove the retriever agent stops within configured bounds
Tests cover file-read actions, import following, and false-positive rejection
Tests assert that final selected files are narrower and better justified than scout-only candidates

tasks.title: Extend retrieval normalization for structural-only recommended evidence output
tasks.description: Update retrieval normalization so raw retriever-agent output becomes a conductor-safe structural artifact carrying strategy metadata, selection tiers, and exact recommended_evidence data.
tasks.deliverable: Normalized retrieval artifacts that remain structural-only while expressing default evidence scope
acceptance_criteria: Normalized retrieval artifacts contain strategy summary, selection tiers, and recommended_evidence
No raw file bodies from the retriever agent leak into stored artifacts
Normalization still enforces absolute paths and valid line-number ranges

tasks.title: Extend artifact inspection and conductor retrieval summaries
tasks.description: Expose the new structural retrieval recommendation data through artifact inspection so the conductor can see selected/reserve files and default evidence scope without seeing raw source.
tasks.deliverable: Conductor-safe retrieval inspection with selected/reserve and default-scope metadata
acceptance_criteria: artifact_inspect surfaces selected/reserve files, default evidence modes, and strategy metadata
Conductor retrieval summaries explain the narrowed default scope without leaking raw code
Evidence-bundle payload inspection remains blocked

tasks.title: Refresh retrieval fixtures and validation tests for the new structural contract
tasks.description: Update sample retrieval fixtures and test coverage to assert the new structural retrieval fields and the absence of raw content leaks.
tasks.deliverable: Fixtures and tests aligned with the revised structural retrieval artifact
acceptance_criteria: Retrieval fixtures reflect the new recommendation-rich structural shape
Normalization tests assert no raw file content leakage
Conductor retrieval-stage tests cover the expanded inspection payload

tasks.title: Implement createRecommendedEvidencePlan from retriever recommendations
tasks.description: Add a helper that builds the default evidence plan directly from retrieval recommended_evidence data rather than using conductor-guessed summary and span defaults.
tasks.deliverable: Recommended evidence-plan authoring helper driven by retrieval artifact recommendations
acceptance_criteria: The default plan can be derived exactly from retrieval recommended_evidence fields
Selected symbols and neighbor-line defaults are preserved without conductor guesswork
Reserve files are excluded from the default plan unless explicitly promoted

tasks.title: Replace naive conductor evidence planning with retriever-authored defaults
tasks.description: Update the extension evidence stage to stop using summary-for-all and first-two-symbol heuristics, and instead materialize the retriever-authored default evidence plan.
tasks.deliverable: Extension evidence stage driven by retriever-authored default scope
acceptance_criteria: The default evidence stage path uses retriever recommendations rather than conductor heuristics
Evidence preview shows a materially narrower plan by default
The conductor can still inspect the plan before materialization

tasks.title: Update budget and evidence tests for retriever-authored default scope
tasks.description: Adjust budget estimation and evidence tests to reflect retriever-authored default evidence scope rather than broad summary coverage across all retrieved files.
tasks.deliverable: Budget and evidence test suite aligned with narrower retriever-authored plans
acceptance_criteria: Budget estimates align with recommended evidence scope rather than summary-for-all defaults
Evidence-plan tests assert the mapping from retrieval recommendations to plan selections
Assembler tests continue to pass with the narrower default plans

tasks.title: Implement conductor override API for evidence-plan adjustments
tasks.description: Add narrow, deterministic override helpers so the conductor can promote reserve files, add or remove symbol spans, and tune neighbor lines without rebuilding the plan from scratch.
tasks.deliverable: Deterministic evidence-plan override API for edge-case conductor adjustments
acceptance_criteria: Override helpers support file promotion/demotion, symbol inclusion/exclusion, and neighbor-line tuning
Overrides validate file and symbol references against the retrieval artifact
Overrides remain additive and deterministic rather than replacing retriever planning wholesale

tasks.title: Wire conductor override flow into the evidence-stage review path
tasks.description: Update the extension evidence-stage flow so the conductor can inspect retriever recommendations, optionally apply narrow overrides, and then preview/materialize the adjusted plan.
tasks.deliverable: Evidence-stage wiring that supports retriever-default plans plus narrow conductor overrides
acceptance_criteria: The evidence-stage path starts from retriever defaults and only then applies optional overrides
Conductor review output clearly distinguishes selected files, reserve files, and adjusted inclusions
Override support does not broaden conductor raw-file visibility

tasks.title: Add override tests and invalid-reference failure coverage
tasks.description: Create focused test coverage for override operations, including reserve-file promotion, symbol-level tuning, and loud failures for bad file or symbol references.
tasks.deliverable: Regression suite for evidence-plan overrides and validation failures
acceptance_criteria: Tests cover reserve-file promotion and span-level adjustment operations
Invalid override targets fail loudly and deterministically
Override tests prove the adjusted plan differs only in the intended places

tasks.title: Update formal specification docs for the agentic retrieval architecture
tasks.description: Bring the formal specification docs and conductor overview in line with the new Stage 1 intent-file exception, scout plus file-reading retriever agent, structural-only retrieval artifact, and retriever-authored default evidence scope.
tasks.deliverable: Specification docs aligned with the implemented agentic retrieval design
acceptance_criteria: Formal docs describe the deterministic scout plus bounded file-reading retriever agent
Docs clearly state that the stored retrieval artifact remains structural-only
Docs describe the retriever as the primary author of default evidence scope and the conductor as a narrow override layer

tasks.title: Add end-to-end regression coverage for intent-file context and narrower evidence bundles
tasks.description: Add integration-level tests that exercise user-supplied intent files, scout plus agent retrieval narrowing, and evidence bundle shrinkage relative to the old broad defaults.
tasks.deliverable: End-to-end regression suite covering the full revised retrieval and evidence path
acceptance_criteria: End-to-end tests prove Stage 1 can use user-supplied file context without broadening conductor repo access
End-to-end tests prove retrieval narrows the default evidence package compared with the previous heuristic default
The evidence assembler materializes only the selected raw evidence while preserving deterministic behavior

tasks.title: Make set_file_mode overrides actually suppress stale span evidence
tasks.description: Ensure set_file_mode changes are semantically complete: switching a plan file to summary, summary+ast, or exclude must not leave old span selections active in the assembler.
tasks.deliverable: Override mode changes that keep plan flags and emitted raw evidence in sync
acceptance_criteria: set_file_mode to summary or summary+ast does not materialize previously selected raw spans unless they remain explicitly intended
set_file_mode to exclude suppresses evidence for the target file rather than leaving stale span selections active
Regression tests cover files with pre-existing spans that are narrowed or excluded via overrides

tasks.title: Make promote_file span-mode overrides produce concrete span behavior
tasks.description: Align promote_file(..., mode: "spans") with actual evidence materialization so the override either seeds concrete default spans from retrieval metadata or fails loudly until symbols are specified.
tasks.deliverable: Promote-file span mode with non-misleading behavior and regression coverage
acceptance_criteria: promote_file with mode=spans no longer yields a spanless plan entry that materializes no raw span evidence
User-facing override help text matches the implemented promote_file span semantics
Tests cover the chosen behavior for reserve-file promotion in spans mode

tasks.title: Render evidence-stage summaries from adjusted plan state
tasks.description: Update conductor evidence-stage summaries so overridden or promoted files are labeled from the current evidence plan rather than stale retrieval defaults.
tasks.deliverable: Evidence-stage summaries that reflect actual adjusted file modes and inclusions
acceptance_criteria: Summary labels derive from the current plan state rather than retrieval defaults when they differ
Promoted reserve files and set_file_mode overrides show the effective mode in the conductor summary
The evidence-stage review output stays consistent with the plan that will actually be previewed and materialized

tasks.title: Add end-to-end coverage for the bounded retriever-agent path
tasks.description: Extend interaction-level regression coverage so the end-to-end agentic retrieval flow exercises retrievalDispatch with a stubbed retrieverAgentModel, not only the scout-only fallback path.
tasks.deliverable: End-to-end regression coverage for the agent-driven retrieval path and its downstream evidence plan
acceptance_criteria: An end-to-end test drives retrievalDispatch with a stubbed retrieverAgentModel rather than relying only on scout-only fallback
The agent-driven path proves that the stored retrieval artifact and recommended evidence plan reflect the narrower agent recommendation
Task completion makes the scope of AR-P8-T2 explicit by covering both scout-only and agent-driven retrieval paths

tasks.title: Reconcile override documentation with actual plan and assembler semantics
tasks.description: Align the formal docs with real override behavior so promote_file and set_file_mode are not documented as fully mode-complete while implementation still has stale-span and spanless-promotion gaps.
tasks.deliverable: Docs and implementation terminology that agree on override semantics
acceptance_criteria: Documentation no longer claims override mode behavior that the current plan and assembler pipeline do not actually honor
promote_file and set_file_mode examples match implemented semantics, including span materialization behavior
A follow-up review can read docs and code without finding contradictions about override behavior

tasks.title: Clean up temporary directories in Stage 1 interaction tests
tasks.description: Add explicit teardown coverage for Stage 1 interaction tests so mkdtemp-created directories are removed after each run and repeated test executions do not leak temp state.
tasks.deliverable: Stage 1 interaction tests with deterministic temp-directory cleanup
acceptance_criteria: Stage 1 interaction tests remove mkdtemp-created directories after each test run
Cleanup remains robust when tests fail mid-run
Repeated local or CI runs do not accumulate Stage 1 temp directories
